sensor.evidence: The HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor is visible at the bottom of the breadboard with its two silver cylinders.

found: VCC pin connected via green wire to breadboard power rail
Trig pin connected via green wire to Arduino pin 10
Echo pin connected via blue wire to Arduino pin 9
GND pin connected via green wire to breadboard ground rail
sensor_wires.evidence: All four pins of the HC-SR04 sensor have wires connected to them, leading to the breadboard or Arduino.

trig.evidence: The green wire from the Trig pin goes to the breadboard and then a blue wire connects that row to Arduino pin 10.

echo.evidence: The blue wire from the Echo pin goes to the breadboard and then a blue wire connects that row to Arduino pin 9.

servo_signal.evidence: The orange signal wire from the servo connector leads to a blue wire that is plugged into Arduino pin 6.

gnd_other_end.evidence: The blue wire from the Arduino GND pin is plugged into the negative power rail of the breadboard.
